It is not God who has given us the spirit of fear; this comes from the adversary. So many of us are fearful of what our peers will say, that we will be looked upon with disdain and criticized if we stand for what is right. But I remind you that "wickedness never was happiness" (Alma 41:10). Evil never was happiness. Sin never was happiness. Happiness lies in the power and the love and the sweet simplicity of the gospel of Jesus Christ. We need not be prudish. We need not slink off in a corner, as it were. We need not be ashamed. We have the greatest thing in the world, the gospel of the risen Lord. Paul gives us a mandate: "Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord" (2 Timothy 1:8 As deacons, teachers, and priests ordained to the holy priesthood, we can stand tall and, without equivocation or fear, declare our testimony of Jesus Christ.

quotes.text: Beloved Brethren , — May grace, mercy and peace rest upon you, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ
■ May grace, mercy and peace rest upon you, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: —
This verse refers to foreordination to eternal life during the premortal existence. This foreordination, or election, had its basis in the Grand Council in Heaven.
quotes.source: New Testament Apostles Testify of Christ [Salt Lake City; Deseret Book
quotes.attr: D. Kelly Ogden and Andrew C. Skinner, New Testament Apostles Testify of Christ [Salt Lake City; Deseret Book, 1998], 218

Beloved Brethren , — May grace, mercy and peace rest upon you, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ

1. Listen to the voice of Jesus Christ, your Lord, your God, and
    your Redeemer, whose word is quick and powerful.

Paul had warned that "grievous wolves" would enter the flock, promoting perverse doctrines (see Acts 20:29-30). Now, with "all they which are in Asia" turning away, we see evidence of widespread apostasy throughout the Church.
